fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 75|critScaling=true}}; applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' kills at least one target, '''Smolder''' restores {{sti|{{as|15 mana}}}}.
fields.description2: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
fields.description3: {{sbc|Tier 1 - 25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
fields.description4: {{sbc|Tier 2 - 125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth 2 {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}} per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts of fire in an arc upon collision that explode at maximum range, dealing {{ap|{{#var:t2_mod}}*100}}% of the same damage to enemies hit. The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
fields.description5: {{sbc|Tier 3 - 225 stacks:}} Enemies hit are set on fire for 3 seconds, causing them to take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{fd|{{#var:t3_ad}}}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#var:t3_i}}}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at 300 against monsters.|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:t3_ad}}/3|round=2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:t3_i}}/3|round=2}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as| of their '''maximum''' health}} each second, capped at {{ap|300/3}} per tick against monsters.}}Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn. Enemy {{tip|champions}} afflicted with the burn are also {{tip|execute|executed}} once '''Smolder''' deals damage to them that would leave them below {{as|{{fd|6.5}}% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
fields.notes:
* Any applied ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' damage is affected by the same damage modifiers as ''Super Scorcher Breath'' and does not benefit from the ability's {{sti|life steal}}.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath's'' damage tags:
** The fireball deals {{tip|spell damage}} and procs {{tip|basic damage}} required effects.
** The explosion deals {{tip|area damage}}.
** The burn deals {{tip|proc damage}}.
* Only '''Smolder's''' damage counts for triggering the execute.
** If the target is below the threshold while afflicted with the burn, they will be executed on the next instance of damage dealt by '''Smolder''', which includes the burn tick.
* If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' would damage the target to below the execution threshold, they are executed on the same damage instance.
* The number of additional bolts launched based on {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks is rounded up.{{bug|2}}
** At 125 {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks, the fireball will launch 3 bolts.
* At 225 {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks, the burn's damage based on the target's health ratio will increase by at least {{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:t3_i}}*2.25}}}}%.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath'' can only hit enemies once per cast.
* The minion and monster damage modifier applies only to the physical damage.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath's'' initial fireball, explosion and extra bolts can all be {{tip|block|blocked}} and {{tip|dodge|dodged}}.
** The application of the burn is negated in all cases.
